subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: After repairing per-source Discord settlement ownership, should yielded cron handoff remain an internal waiting state or become the permanent public `deferred` status across persistence, Gateway protocol, plugin SDK/hooks, CLI, QA, and Control UI?
rationale: The P1 ownership defect has a mechanical repair, but repository policy does not allow the review to infer a new persisted and plugin-facing compatibility contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep Deferral Internal
options.body: Preserve existing public cron statuses and represent yielded-parent waiting through internal lifecycle state and diagnostics.

options.title: Approve Public Deferred
options.body: Adopt `deferred` as a supported public contract with documented compatibility and exact-head fresh-install and upgrade evidence.

options.title: Split Contract Follow-up
options.body: Land the narrow lifecycle and Discord ownership repair first, then review the public status design in a maintainer-owned follow-up.

recommendation.title: Keep Deferral Internal
recommendation.body: Preserve existing public cron statuses and represent yielded-parent waiting through internal lifecycle state and diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing yielded-subagent pause contract dates to his commit, and this decision determines how that lifecycle expands into public cron and plugin surfaces.
